reference: The corresponding original operative splash in public/art/splash/
instructions: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Asset type: unlockable alternate combat pose splash art for original cyberpunk game BULLETPUNK. Reference image is the exact character identity and art direction to preserve: face, age, ethnicity, hair, outfit, weapon, palette and premium painterly illustration. Create a NEW distinct dynamic combat stance, vertical 2:3 waist-up portrait. Same individual, face at upper third, head entirely within frame, strong silhouette and expressive eyes. Real hands and believable anatomy. Dramatic diagonal composition in industrial night atmosphere with turquoise and amber rim light. No text, no logos, no watermark. Do not simply crop or tilt the reference: change actual body/arm/weapon pose.
